name: devmate
description: Local-first MCP development gateway for ChatGPT with team RBAC, durable jobs, external runners, approvals, production tunnels, Git workflows, and optional platform plugins.

devMate.port.description: Local gateway port. Auto-increments if busy.

devMate.deploymentMode.description: Deployment profile. Personal preserves zero-configuration local behavior; team enables scoped members and leases; production adds hardened ingress limits and dual-control approvals.

devMate.tunnelProvider.description: Public ingress provider. Cloudflare Quick Tunnel is for development only; production should use a stable managed tunnel or external HTTPS ingress.

devMate.publicUrl.description: Stable public HTTPS origin without /mcp. Required for production and published review previews.

devMate.cloudflareCommandPath.description: Optional path to the cloudflared executable.

devMate.ngrokTrafficPolicyFile.description: Optional ngrok Traffic Policy file passed with --traffic-policy-file.

devMate.tunnelAutoRestart.description: Automatically restart managed tunnel processes after unexpected exits.

devMate.tunnelMaxRestarts.description: Maximum automatic tunnel restarts with exponential backoff.

devMate.teamRequireWorkspaceLeaseForWrit.description: Require a principal-owned workspace lease before team members mutate, execute, use Git, or publish.

devMate.productionMaxRequestBytes.description: Maximum declared MCP request body size in production profiles.

devMate.productionRequestsPerMinute.description: Per-principal MCP request limit per minute.

devMate.productionMaxConcurrentRequests.description: Maximum concurrent MCP requests across the gateway.

devMate.productionMaxConcurrentPerPrinci.description: Maximum concurrent MCP requests for one authenticated principal.

devMate.productionRequestTimeoutMs.description: Maximum request socket timeout for long-running MCP calls.

devMate.allowedPublicHosts.description: Additional Host headers accepted by the production gateway. The configured publicUrl host is added automatically.

devMate.ngrokUseManagedAccount.description: Use the ngrok Authtoken saved by DevMate in VS Code Secret Storage.

devMate.ngrokUrl.description: Optional stable ngrok URL owned by the selected account. Do not include /mcp.

devMate.ngrokPoolingEnabled.description: Advanced ngrok endpoint pooling. Keep disabled unless every pooled agent intentionally serves the same trusted deployment.

devMate.autoUseCurrentWorkspace.description: Use the current VS Code folder as active writable workspace on quick start.

devMate.defaultCommandTimeoutMs.description: Default timeout for command and Git tools.

devMate.autoCopyUrl.description: Copy the verified ChatGPT MCP URL automatically after Start.

devMate.defaultStartCommand.description: Optional command to run after the gateway is ready.

devMate.permissionProfile.description: Base local permission profile. Team roles and workspace scopes add a second authorization layer.

devMate.blockDangerousOperations.description: Block obvious high-risk shell and Git operations when the selected permission profile applies guards.

devMate.confirmBeforePush.description: Block MCP push requests until deliberately disabled.

devMate.publicHealthDetails.description: Expose detailed /health information. Keep false on public deployments.

devMate.requireAuthToken.description: Require an owner or team bearer token for public MCP requests.

devMate.allowDirectoryMutations.description: Allow directory delete or move operations.

devMate.backupRetentionDays.description: Days to keep automatic file backups.

devMate.auditRetentionDays.description: Days to keep mutation, command, team, approval, job, runner, and request audit entries.
